name: inter-pair-member-flap
purpose: Take the inter-pair bond member between switch-a1 and switch-b1 down and back. Measure both host streams, which cross the inter-pair bond, and sample the host entries of both hosts on all four switches.
reasons: Step Inter-pair member down is fail.
Step Inter-pair member back is fail.

statements.statement: Both MLAG pairs are connected, with switch-a1 and switch-b1 as MLAG primaries.
Pair A is the RSTP root bridge with switch-a1's bridge ID, and pair B reaches it through the inter-pair bond.
Every bridge port of the four switches forwards, and the host ports are edge ports.
The inter-pair bond runs with lacp-strict=no on all four switches.
Both inter-pair bond members are synchronized, collecting and distributing at all four ends.
Both cables of every host are eligible in its LACP bond.

steps.name: Inter-pair member down
steps.expected: switch-a1 and switch-b1 each lose their only inter-pair bond member. The bond keeps forwarding over the member between switch-a2 and switch-b2, and traffic that reaches switch-a1 or switch-b1 crosses its peer link.
